turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.
Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Part of Pretty Good AI. How may I help you today?
Hi there! I'm thinking about becoming a new patient and just have a few questions before I book an appointment. First, could you tell me what days and hours the clinic is open?
The clinic is open Monday. Tuesday, and Thursday from 9AM to 4PM, Wednesday from 12PM to 7PM, and Friday from 9AM to 12PM. What other questions can I answer for you?
Got it, thanks! Do you happen to be open on Saturdays?
The clinic is not open on Saturdays.
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
Yes, actually! Could I come in early on a Wednesday, around 9am, before work? I just want to make sure that fits within your hours.
On Wednesdays, the clinic opens at 12PM, so we don't have morning appointments that day.
Would you like to hear about early morning options on other days?
No, that’s okay. I just wanted to check on that. Can you tell me the clinic's address? And do you have more than one location? I thought a friend mentioned a Nashville office.
The clinic's address is 1234 Recovery Way, Suite 200, Austin, Texas 78701. We only have this one location in Austin. There isn't a Nashville office.
Anything else I can help with?
Just one last thing — is there parking available at your clinic?
Yes. There is free patient parking in the surface lot in front of the building. Let me know if you have any other questions.
Thanks so much for all the information! I appreciate your help. Have a great day!
If you have more questions or want to book an appointment, just give us a call. Take care.
